assertion_results.text: Bug parsing correctly extracts all four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) using the heading formats from bug-template-mock.md (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 40-45: Required Section Validation table shows all four sections present with heading formats `### **Issue Description**`, `### **Steps to Reproduce**`, `### **Expected Result**`, `### **Actual Result**` — each marked 'Yes ✓'. Lines 55-76 then show parsed content for all four sections.

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md lines 22-29: 'section_name = line[3:]  # Extracts heading text after "## "' followed by explanation that 'line[3:]' produces '"Migration Patterns  "' with trailing spaces that are NOT stripped. Lines 55-56: '**Divergence point**: heading extraction at `line[3:]` — does not call `.strip()` on the extracted text.' Also in the summary table line 117: 'Defect — extraction | `line[3:]` does not strip trailing whitespace from heading text'.

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md lines 15-24: 'the `plan-feature` skill's convention lookup extracts heading text from `CONVENTIONS.md` using `line[3:]` ... This extraction does **not** strip trailing whitespace.' (what is broken). Lines 29-31: affected file is 'plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md — Convention lookup section' (where it is broken). Lines 49-64: 'Reproducer Strategy' section provides step-by-step instructions to set up a CONVENTIONS.md fixture with trailing-whitespace heading and assert before/after fix behavior (how to verify).

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion — before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 95-96: '## Acceptance Criteria' followed immediately by '- [ ] **Reproducer test**: a plan-feature eval using a `CONVENTIONS.md` fixture with trailing-whitespace headings fails before the fix and passes after (confirms the bug is fixed and cannot regress)' — this is the first bullet, before the fix-specific criterion on line 97.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement — with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 101-102: '## Test Requirements' followed immediately by '- [ ] **Reproducer test** (first): add a trailing-whitespace fixture ... containing `## Migration Patterns  ` with two trailing spaces followed by `Add Index::create() for all FK columns.`; assert that the generated task description contains the exact string `Per CONVENTIONS.md §Migration Patterns: add \`Index::create()\` for all FK columns.` — this test must fail against the pre-fix code and pass after the fix'. This is the first test requirement with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce.
